arguments.where_clause: card_id IN (SELECT id FROM cards WHERE card_type = 'Debit (Prepaid)')
arguments.explanation: Flags every transaction made on a card whose type is prepaid debit, regardless of transaction type, amount or merchant.
assumptions: 'Prepaid debit cards' is taken to mean card_type = 'Debit (Prepaid)' exactly, and not the plain 'Debit' type.
The rule covers all transaction types (chip, swipe, online) and all amounts, including negative amounts.
